title: twin sleeper sofa
text: twin sleeper sofa. I needed a sofa bed for a smaller area - this fit the bill perfectly.  I love the olivish green color.  The bed portion pops out as it should and the memory foam mattress will work for my 6 or 9 year old grandsons.  It did need to be assembled - my husband and got it together in about 1hour - a bit of a struggle.  The frustration and reason for 4 instead of 5 stars - NO DIRECTIONS AT ALL!  Nor could I find ANY directions for our specific bed on Youtube or otherwise.  THAT was more difficult than it needed to be.  We eventually got it done, but would have been a LOT faster with directions.  Hope they make sure they all have directions before they go out now!  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Novogratz Brittany Sleeper Sofa with Memory Foam Mattress, Mustard, Twin
features: Loveseat Sleeper Sofa dazzles with hallmark design in the form of dapper vertical channel tufting on the backrest and piping along the sofa bed’s slim silhouette and rounded arms
Seat cushions consist of 90 independently encased coils to provide superior comfort for firm support

Included Twin size medium-firm mattress is comprised of 3” Memory Foam encased in a soft-to-the-touch poly-knit cover to effortlessly contour to your body for even weight distribution. Pullout mattress frame easily folds for quick couch to bed conversion for relaxed sitting or sleeping

Ships in one box and it is easy to assemble. Available in Twin and Queen sizes in a blue, gray, mustard or green soft linen upholstery. 1-year limited warranty. Sofa made in Vietnam and mattress made in Taiwan.

Sofa dimensions: 54"L x 32"W x 35.5"H. Bed dimensions: 86"L x 54"W x 35.5"H. Twin mattress dimensions: 72"L x 37"W x 3"H. Sofa weight limit: 400 lbs. Bed weight limit: 225 lbs. Shipping dimensions: 46.5"L x 30.5"W x 26"H. Net weight: 114.5 lbs. Gross weight: 131 lbs.
description: When it comes to saving space without compromising on comfort, the stylish Brittany Loveseat Sleeper sofa from Novogratz has you covered - and then some. The sofa comes in a stunning modern design, with straight lines, wooden legs, and contemporary linen upholstery that’s accented with piping details and a ribbed tufted backrest. It’s the perfect sofa for stretching out, curling up or just hanging around, with encased coil cushions that always keep you comfortable. Best of all, the Brittany sleeper sofa opens up to reveal a comfy sleeping space. Just pull out the memory foam mattress, which is specially designed to contour your body and distribute weight evenly - helping you get a good night’s sleep. The Brittany is great for small apartments or condos, the guest room or even your teen’s bedroom. A warm duvet, some comfy sheets, your favorite pillow, or just a throw. There are lots of great ways to lie back and enjoy this luxurious sleeper sofa.
